source.title: PIPELINE GATE 08/09 — Editorial Publish, Supplier Price Comparison & Pricing Safety
source.body:
# PIPELINE GATE 08/09 — Editorial Approval, Multi-Supplier Offer Comparison, Retail Price Decision & Safe Publication

**Nature:** acceptance and gap-review checkpoint. Parent AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#144, EC-00. Existing implementation history: AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#141 catalog publication, AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#136 offer safe commit, AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#93/AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#123 supplier selection/PO and fallback, AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#124 finance, AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#12 admin review. This issue MUST NOT create a second sourcing, catalog or pricing engine. No independent implementation verified as of 22 Oct 2026.

## Business outcome (after Stage 06/07)

Owner/authorized staff reviews candidate's exact variant/SKU identity, Brand/Line/Ingredient/frequency rules, evidence, sourced actual front packshot, eligible supplier offers and unit economics; makes APPROVE, CORRECT, MERGE_INTO_EXISTING, REJECT, HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE decision. If eligible for publication, creates exactly one canonical Product+Variant/SKU and approved scoped SupplierSKU aliases, links the correct SupplierOffer(s), approves product selling price explicitly/separately, and makes it actually sellable only under live catalog/quote/sourcing requirements. Uploading a new supplier price must NEVER automatically change the customer's storefront selling price.

## PRICE ARCHITECTURE — three distinct truths

1. **SupplierOffer truth** (by supplier + exact canonical SKU, plus pack/MOQ/qty/discount terms): each supplier has own quoted purchase cost with source, observedAt, receivedAt, effective period, reliability/stock signal, price basis and approval. File upload does NOT make availability a reservation. Offers are retained separately and source-scoped.
2. **Procurement/sourcing recommendation** (per demand/batch and actual supplier coverage): filter **eligible** suppliers based on verified identical sellable unit/formula/pack, fresh valid offer, acceptable price/qty semantics, MOQ/quantity, supplier active/approved, delivery window to Hub, supplier terms, exception status. Compute comparable EGP effective landed unit cost = authoritative purchase line cost after eligible volume discount/bonus allocation + actual attributable supplier-to-hub transport/fees/tax where applicable and known. Avoid artificial allocation of fixed order costs per item where bundle ordering affects choice; calculate batch-level economic trade-off. Choose lowest total feasible landed cost **subject to** fulfillment/quality constraints and vendor risk, not just lowest raw number. In a tie, prefer freshness, reliability and fastest workable confirmation. Record reason and fallback. Reuse existing sourcing algorithm and PO allocation lineage (AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#93/AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#123), do not implement second selection service in Stage 08.
3. **Retail SellingPrice policy**: customer price is an independent versioned approved EGP amount for a specific sellable SKU/variant, not minimum, mean or median of suppliers' purchase quotes, and not supplier MSRP/reference retail. Build read-only suggested price or min-margin warning only from actual approved sourcing economics and owner-configured contribution rules: procurement cost + direct delivery subsidy (only actual owner share), packaging, fees/returns allowance where agreed and taxes where applicable, then target contribution margin. Do NOT invent a markup %, apply margin on unrelated units, invent Egypt cosmetics price regulation or activate competitor scraping. Seller price remains existing approved value until authorized change with history. Exact value on PDP/cart/checkout must be consistent and checkout repricing explicitly reconfirmed; no silent order repricing when supplier changes after customer order. If no trustworthy cost/sell price, HOLD price/sellability, not fake EGP.

## Research-backed design patterns (reference, no external vendor integration)

* Microsoft Dynamics 365 vendor list prices, vendor agreements/discounts, lowest effective eligible source price and separate selling price management: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/unified-pricing-management/upm-vendor-list-price](<https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/unified-pricing-management/upm-vendor-list-price>) ; [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/purchase-agreements](<https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/procurement/purchase-agreements>)
* Dynamics multisource assignment respects supplier eligibility and MOQ and warns that vendor scheduling limitations can make cheaper allocations late: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/source-from-multiple-vendors](<https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/master-planning/source-from-multiple-vendors>)
* Oracle NetSuite: link the same item to multiple vendors, each with own purchase price/preferred rate: [https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/netsuite/ns-online-help/section_N2369863.html](<https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/netsuite/ns-online-help/section_N2369863.html>)
* Google Merchant checkout/landing consistency and price transparency useful UX reference (not claiming Google Merchant policy governs ShinaCare absent that channel): [https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/9158778?hl=en](<https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/9158778?hl=en>)
* Shopify differentiates cost per item, sale price and estimated profit margin: [https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/products/details/product-details-page/](<https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/products/details/product-details-page/>)
* Use median of same-unit valid supplier costs only as an OUTLIER SIGNAL if enough independent comparable quotes exist; no average-as-purchase-cost, no arbitrary 3-supplier consensus requirement, no auto-rejection based on 2 legitimate prices. NIST: [https://www.nist.gov/publications/possible-advantages-robust-evaluation-comparisons](<https://www.nist.gov/publications/possible-advantages-robust-evaluation-comparisons>)
* PostgreSQL 17 uniqueness and atomic UPSERT, with transactions/optimistic concurrency after checking actual Prisma version: [https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/indexes-unique.html](<https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/indexes-unique.html>) ; [https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/sql-insert.html](<https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/sql-insert.html>) ; [https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/v6/prisma-client/queries/transactions](<https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/v6/prisma-client/queries/transactions>)

## Publication workflow / source-of-truth boundaries

1. Stage 07 ProductCandidate includes authoritative sources, original rows, Brand/Line/Ingredient links, exact formulation net size, usage frequency structured rules, real front image, and unresolved conflicts.
2. **Re-run Stage 04/06 dedup immediately before publication**, searching active, unpublished/inactive SKU, pending candidates across supplier sources. Concurrent candidate creates/approval handled via DB uniqueness on genuinely verified identifiers, transaction/conflict retry and manual ambiguous review. Manual approve cannot override hard identity mismatch silently.
3. Product fact review: per field official manufacturer evidence versus supplier rumor, concentration %, usage frequency and safety caution, no auto-publish unsupported recommendation claims. Missing optional logo/back texture image doesn't hold; missing real exact front packshot means publication HOLD (but candidate/import stays).
4. SupplierOffer comparison: show per supplier **verified purchase EGP per same sellable unit**, declared MOQ/pack, freshness, quantity signal confidence, expected Hub readiness and source; mark cheapest **feasible** not absolute cheapest. Store SupplierOffer independent from product.
5. Financial decision: auto-suggest only if documented policy; actual storefront SellingPrice requires approved configured price/policy and authorized action, versioned snapshot, e.g. PRICE_REVIEW_REQUIRED. No invented market price, no automatic margin promise from stock file.
6. Atomic-ish Catalog+Alias+SupplierOffer source-link publish with existing domain owner services, idempotency key/revision/authorized actor/audit. If operations span services, use existing transaction and recoverable outbox/state, never lie about half-committed success.
7. Display: ADMIN shows APPROVED_CATALOG vs PUBLISHED_SELLABLE vs OFFER_UPDATED vs CANDIDATE_PENDING counts truthfully. Supplier sees row-specific actual outcomes, cannot access competitor supplier costs, founder margin or customer PII.

## Adversarial scenarios (required)

* Same product from suppliers A/B/C at 180/165/175 EGP, supplier B MOQ 20, C stale; demand one unit → A eligible, B cannot fulfill MOQ without approved batch and C cannot be treated fresh. No blind cheapest quote.
* Purchase cost A=500 per carton of 5, B=130 per piece: compare 100 vs 130 after verified package normalization; not 500 vs 130.
* One supplier offers paid 10 + bonus 2, discount by pack, extra courier-to-hub fixed charges or rare returns fee → calculate actual cost for *eligible purchased quantity and batch*; avoid counting bonus as available stock if not guaranteed.
* Supplier offers 100, 102, 800 same verified SKU; extreme price is flag/REVIEW with same-unit evidence, NOT selling price 334 or automatic trusted supplier disqualification. If only one source offer, supplier cost can be retained but no fake median or 'market certified' badge.
* Brand-new product has no own approved retail price => catalog draft can exist but not customer-sellable; administrative decision/approved pricing rule required.
* Competitor public market price unavailable, ambiguous variant, unlicensed scraper, old supplier MSRP → do not assert market benchmarking or overwrite retail price; optional future FX-06 price watch.
* Seller price is 300, actual eligible purchase cost is 350 on same unit; financial HOLD and protected sourcing/order handling, never sell new order at assumed loss or secretly raise accepted order price.
* Supplier price increases AFTER existing customer order placed or PO confirmed; immutable order accepted quote and procurement PO costs survive; trigger permitted re-sourcing/customer choice or margin alert, never retroactive change.
* New Candidate is actually an inactive SKU or two approvals race → dedup and re-read; if unsure HOLD/REVIEW.
* Missing/incorrect image 200ml while product is 400ml, version changed, unsupported INCI percentage/frequency, wrong line → HOLD publication and correction.
* Same SKU different suppliers with conflicting file quantities, price-only upload marked fresh stock, forged source timestamp → no cross-supplier overwrite or fake ready stock.
* Authorized Admin vs Supplier role attempts to override retail price, review approval, inspect competitor costs or publish product → explicit RBAC/ABAC protection + audit.
* Concurrent approval and source-price updates, timeout after transaction/replay/canceled review → stable idempotent final state, no duplicate SKU/offers.

## Acceptance / evidence

- [ ] Inspect current repo source path and schema for RetailPrice, SupplierOffer, Sourcing select/rank, Candidate Review/Publish, alias/fingerprint and invoice/PO snapshots; document actual reuse vs gap.
- [ ] Real approved product with two suppliers + staged prices shows separate offers and correct lowest **feasible** sourcing choice using policy, MOQ, units, freshness and readiness.
- [ ] Test single supplier, three outlier quotes, stale offer, offer absence, MOQ/bonus, 500 carton vs per unit, delivery charge/pack costs and unknown margin with exact expected results.
- [ ] Explicit approved EGP retail price independent of supplier cost; read quote/storefront does not silently alter; customer accepted price/PO preserved through cost update.
- [ ] Authorized editor reviews facts, images, research provenance; new SKU publish and hidden/duplicate/race scenarios use transaction/version and leave exactly one canonical sellable SKU.
- [ ] Candidate without exact front photo and evidence remains private; missing optional brand/line asset does not block.
- [ ] Supplier/Admin permission tests, audit changes, cross-supplier financial privacy and no untrusted AI source promotion.
- [ ] Actual Supplier UI import status, Admin review, Product/Variant/SupplierOffer links and Storefront sellability visible; backend DB + UI evidence recorded.

**GO/NO-GO:** no unauthorized publication, wrong price or same-unit comparison, false offer availability, duplicate SKU, cross-supplier leak, forced customer repricing or mutable historical procurement snapshot. Current design is PROPOSED/UNVERIFIED, not evidence of implementation.

**Stage 09** = final adversarial end-to-end pilot and measurable GO/NO-GO across all nine Stage issue gates. Don't pull later standalone storefront/Hub/Driver/Core feature development into this Supplier Ingestion-only acceptance.
